beats: Hook: eight people at a round table, each holding one page, pass pages to the left until everyone has read every page (line_ring_table_eight, the cover).
Recap: Ulysses is capped by the number of heads; ring attention splits only the sequence (slide 16; line_cp_pie_slices from L07-01 if it is in the library).
Core (slides 16-17): each GPU keeps its own queries at home and only key/value blocks travel, one block per round, combined blockwise like FlashAttention (line_ring_keep_card).
Overlap (slide 18): read the page in hand while the next one arrives, two trays used in turn: ping-pong buffers and asynchronous send/receive (line_ring_two_trays).
With TP (slides 19-21): one ring per TP lane, and with GQA only one small KV head per GPU travels (line_ring_many_tables).
Pitfall (slide 23): with the causal mask early tokens look back at little and late tokens at everything, so one GPU idles while another drowns (line_ring_lopsided_work).
Fix 1, striped (slide 24): deal the tokens out in turn like cards (line_ring_deal_cards): about 1.4x on 8 GPUs at 8k.
Fix 2, zigzag (slide 25): cut into 2N chunks and fold, each GPU gets one early and one late chunk (line_zigzag_fold_strip), the work evens out (line_ring_even_work): about 1.7x, the usual default.
Llama 3 CP (slides 26-27): documents packed into one long sequence make the masks messy, so each GPU all-gathers the small GQA keys/values at once (line_ring_packed_docs, line_ring_all_gather_pile).
Takeaway: communication grows with the length, compute with its square, so the talking hides behind the work (reuse line_balance).
Cover (line_cover_l07_02; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): eight readers round one table pass their pages to the left like a wheel.

drawings.name: line_ring_table_eight
drawings.prompt: Seen from above at a steep angle: one round table with eight invented readers seated evenly around it (simple round faces, dot eyes, eight different hairstyles: round glasses, a high ponytail, a cap worn backwards, short curls, a bun, a headband, long straight hair, a buzz cut). Each reader holds one sheet of paper and, all at the same moment, hands it to the neighbour on their left while receiving one from the right, so eight pages are in motion around the table like a wheel; small curved motion lines follow the pages around the ring. Square image 1024x1024; the table and readers fill about 92% of the width and of the height, centred. The pages are blank: no writing, no text, no letters, no numbers.

Each reader holds one sheet of paper and, all at the same moment, hands it to the neighbour on their left while receiving one from the right, so eight pages turn round the table like a wheel; small curved motion lines follow the pages round the ring. The pages are blank. Landscape image 1536x1024, made as a cover picture: leave the top third of the picture completely empty, plain white (a title is lettered there later); the whole scene sits in the lower two thirds, centred, about 88% of the width wide, with a white margin on every side. Use few, large, bold, clearly separated shapes with white space between them, so the idea reads at a glance even when the picture is shown only 500 pixels wide: no small clutter, no busy background.
